title: McDonnell instructs staff to study UFOs

tellings.quote: there are declassified papers to show McDonald uh instructing his company

plain: James McDonnell, head of the aircraft maker McDonnell Douglas, told his company to study UFOs. The writer Nick Cook, who investigates secret aerospace research, says on the show that "there are declassified papers to show" this, though he does not quote them. If true, it would mean a major defense company took UFOs seriously enough to look into them.
